verdict.rationale: A probe confirms an official Stripe CLI is documented at docs.stripe.com/stripe-cli. Radar exposes API resources (reviews, early fraud warnings, value lists) that such a CLI could plausibly drive. However, the evidence is a single probe mention and never shows the CLI covering Radar workflows such as rules, reviews or lists. Missing for 10: documented Radar-specific CLI commands (e.g. managing value lists or approving reviews), CLI usage details or agent-oriented CLI workflows, and independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI use with Radar.
